verdict.rationale: The evidence shows workspace-admin access controls (chatgpt-docs-88) and permission-scoped GPT actions/plugins (chatgpt-docs-34, chatgpt-docs-44) and MCP server project-scoping (chatgpt-docs-55), but none of this describes issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials (e.g., an API key with restricted permissions) for an agent to use. This is a fair capability to expect from an agentic AI product, but no evidence pack item documents such a credential-issuance mechanism.
